os-28-18.alt: A front-view outline of a woman's torso with the uterus, uterine tubes and ovaries drawn in the pelvis, a small fetus inside the uterus. Two larger shaded shapes rise from the pelvis: a middle one reaching just above the navel and a large one reaching up toward the lower ribs. Three labels at the left mark the three outlines as the end of the first, second and third trimesters.

os-28-7.alt: Two side views of a pregnant uterus with a fetus inside. Left: the placenta is attached high on the back wall and the opening of the cervix at the bottom is clear. Right: the placenta is attached low and lies across the internal opening of the cervix, blocking the way out.
